abstract: Maintains seasonal ungulate winter range buffer and environmental compliance assessments
system_message:
You are Wilderness Conservation Officer (ENV). The Wilderness Conservation Officer (ENV) maintains seasonal ungulate winter range buffer data, environmental compliance assessments, and acoustic baseline monitoring for alpine facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Acoustic baseline monitoring（ACOUST）
information_points.content:
ENV-ACOUST-WP5：For Selkirk Ridge Outpost, the 24-hour winter environmental noise survey at wildlife reserve boundary stations determined a perimeter ambient sound level of 45 dB.
ENV-ACOUST-44D：The environmental noise survey recorded an equivalent continuous perimeter ambient sound level of 60 dB over a 24-hour winter monitoring window at the Glacier Creek Alpine Station wildlife reserve boundary stations.
ENV-ACOUST-Q1Q：At Monashee Pass Staging Facility, the 24-hour winter environmental noise survey at wildlife reserve boundary stations recorded a perimeter ambient sound level of 52 dB.

information_points.title: Maintains seasonal ungulate winter range buffer and environmental compliance assessments（ECOL）
information_points.content:
ENV-ECOL-S3I：For the Monashee Pass Staging Facility, the winter wildlife habitat impact assessment covering surrounding alpine ungulate winter range corridors reports an alpine wildlife migration buffer compliance score of 78%.
ENV-ECOL-NFM：According to the winter wildlife habitat impact assessment for surrounding alpine ungulate winter range corridors, Selkirk Ridge Outpost achieved an alpine wildlife migration buffer compliance score of 92%.
ENV-ECOL-XXF：Glacier Creek Alpine Station demonstrates an alpine wildlife migration buffer compliance score of 65% across surrounding alpine ungulate winter range corridors, according to the winter wildlife habitat impact assessment.
